messages:
sam: Hey folks — first week, trying to get my PR pipeline green but Buildkite fails on the docker push step. Not sure who to ping for registry perms. Any quick pointers? :wave:

buildkite-bot: Build #1245 failed on 'publish-image' step
  exit status 1
  error: denied: requested access to the resource is denied

sam: Full error from the job log:
```
> docker push 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/service:pr-42
The push refers to repository [123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/service]
7f3a2b1: Preparing
unauthorized: authentication required
```

maria: welcome aboard, sam! :tada: This usually means the CI role doesn't have ECR push permissions or the ECR creds in Buildkite are stale. Are you using the org Buildkite pipeline or a forked PR?

sam: org pipeline (not a fork). I followed the onboarding doc but I might have missed a step when I requested registry access.

kevin: tagging infra — @maria fyi we need to check the CI IAM role policy on the repo's Pipeline-ARN. Quick checklist:
- Confirm Buildkite IAM role has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken + ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability + ecr:PutImage + ecr:InitiateLayerUpload + ecr:UploadLayerPart + ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
- Ensure the account ID in the pipeline env matches the ECR account
- Rotate the ECR creds in Buildkite if they were updated recently

maria: Sam — two quick ways to move: 1) I can add the role-to-policy change (will take ~10m) or 2) temp workaround: push to the dev registry we use for onboarding (dev-reg.redwood-inference.internal) and we can retag for you. Which do you prefer?

sam: If you can do the role change that would be great — I don't want to add more manual steps to my PR.

maria: OK will do. pinging infra oncall. In the meantime, if anyone else hits this, here's the minimal policy we apply to the CI role:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "ecr:GetAuthorizationToken",
        "ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability",
        "ecr:PutImage",
        "ecr:InitiateLayerUpload",
        "ecr:UploadLayerPart",
        "ecr:CompleteLayerUpload"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

jen: FYI, if the Buildkite pipeline is using temporary AWS creds from the org vault, make sure the terraform change that created the role was applied to the right account. We had a similar onboarding flake last quarter where the role existed in staging only.

maria: infra oncall just confirmed — role missing ecr:PutImage. I've pushed a policy update and triggered a rebuild for sam's PR.

buildkite-bot: Re-triggered build #1245 for pr/42 by maria

buildkite-bot: Build #1246 started

sam: Looks like the new run succeeded! Publish step passed and image pushed. Thanks so much, all. :relieved:

kevin: Awesome — added a short note to the onboarding checklist about verifying ECR push perms and the exact policy snippet. Saved a future new hire a headache. :memo:
